description: Frictionless Table Schema of Platform/01-store/forms/rights-checks.probes.tsv (ADR-0125 addenda (12), (13); P01.228). Every field is a raw string: no type coercion. Constraints only where the header of the form or the existing check states them; CEL, JSON, owner, typed, numeric and prose-agreement rules stay with the existing checks.

fields.name: n
fields.description: A row n of rights-checks.tsv, 0 for pass; no foreign key: 0 is no row, and the evaluation stays with the existing check.

fields.name: sock
fields.description: The caller transport role by P/01.2-R017 (#var sock of the table); checked by the existing check.

fields.name: body
fields.description: The request object as JSON, or for nopair why the row has no pair; JSON and the outcome stay with the existing check.
